description:
Generalize the dispatch CLI surface from compactor-only to arbitrary roles (ARCH §3.4). The v0.3 shape ships only `lernie dispatch compactor <repo> <branch>`; v0.4 needs `lernie dispatch worker <repo> <parent-branch> --goal <goal>` (and the primitive must be extensible to verifier/critic/etc. without further surgery).

Scope:
- Refactor src/bin/lernie.rs DispatchRole subcommand and src/prompt/dispatcher.rs Dispatcher trait to take a role name as a parameter, not as a subcommand variant.
- Generalize the branch + worktree spawn logic now living in compactor::run so it is reusable across (a) compactor case, (b) v0.4 worker subagent case. Subagent branch name = full hyphenated descent of conv-ids (parent branch + '-' + new short-id). Worktree at <conv-repo>/<full-descent>/, sibling of root/.
- Soul resolution generalized: load <conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md for the dispatched role (already works for compactor; extend to worker).
- Goal source: command-line --goal flag for v0.4 (the dispatch tool in Phase 2 will pass it through).
- Existing compactor case must continue to work unchanged — its goal is still the boilerplate 'summarize the parent branch's work', no behavior delta.

Out of scope:
- The dispatch tool itself (Phase 2).
- The await tool (Phase 3).
- The subagent's own multi-step loop (Phase 4) — Phase 1 only spawns the branch + writes goal.md/soul.md + dispatch commit, then exits.

Tests: cover the new lernie dispatch worker shape end-to-end at the integration level (real git, fake adapter), plus the unit-level coverage of the generalized spawn helper. tarpaulin --fail-under 100 must remain green.

Done-when: lernie dispatch worker <repo> <branch> --goal '...' creates a sibling worktree at <repo>/<branch>-<sub-id>/, branch <branch>-<sub-id> off the parent branch's tip, with goal.md and soul.md committed as the dispatch commit, and exits 0. Compactor case unchanged.
title: v0.4 Phase 1: generalize lernie dispatch CLI for arbitrary roles
